verdict.rationale: AutoGen Studio supports exporting team configurations as JSON or Python code and the framework has component serialization/deserialization features, which are open, portable formats. However, there is no evidence of exporting broader user data (conversation history, memory stores, logs) in a comprehensive open-format package, and no documentation of a full account/data 'leave' export process. Missing for 10: evidence of exporting full conversation/memory history, a documented data-portability/export-all workflow, and independent confirmation of format openness beyond configs.
